meanings.implemented_on_branch: Legacy implementation enum retained for checker compatibility: the recorded bounded acceptance passed at its source checkpoint. Read the separate merge field for current inclusion in main. This is not new owner acceptance or deployment.
meanings.accepted_implementation: Owner-accepted capability after review; a merge alone does not set this field. No requirement is promoted by this documentation update.
meanings.main_partial: Historical merge-state label for partial main behaviour.
meanings.main_partial_branch_extended: Historical merge-state label for main behaviour extended on an unmerged branch.
meanings.branch_only: The relevant implementation is not yet included in main.
meanings.merged_to_main: The recorded implementation, even if partial, is included in the stated main commit; this does not finish the requirement.

workstreams.console: Premium console and truthful connected states
workstreams.runtime: Host lifecycle, distributed nodes, workers and files

no_completion_percentage: The 33 registered requirements are not weighted effort or a verified denominator for every conversation; no whole-product completion percentage is claimed.

post_merge_reconciliation.scope: Merge/delivery reconciliation and clearer current notes only. Requirement IDs, memory mappings, dependencies, implementation/integration/decision classifications and prior acceptance references are retained. Earlier detailed notes remain in the exact prior register. No code or deployment change.
post_merge_reconciliation.promotion_policy: Current-product engineering and future research/opt-in synthetic groundwork; no automatic private-data, hosted or commercial activation.

requirements.title: Optional human-owned Markdown vaults
requirements.notes: Read-only scanner and selected-vault identity are integrated. Full Obsidian compatibility, documents and sync remain unfinished.

requirements.title: Stable document identity and revision history
requirements.notes: Markdown identity, conservative rename continuity and duplicate rejection are integrated. Known sync-conflict identity defects were fixed; unrecognised tool copies remain separate notes. See prior register for the two detailed defect descriptions.

requirements.title: Source location, revision and basis on every derived memory
requirements.notes: Notes, reviewed claims, conversation packets, console projection and connector imports carry revision/hash. Document ingestion remains pending.

requirements.title: Distinct memory types
requirements.notes: Bounded conversations/manual statements and capture types exist. Commitments feed commitment review; procedures feed a read-only registry; other types are not routine input. Automatic capture policies are pending.

requirements.title: Inspectable, editable proposals before promotion
requirements.notes: Explicit capture with preview, separate review and retention; console queue accepts valid periods/replacements, disputes and withdrawal. Recorded implementation classification retained, not a fresh capability acceptance.

requirements.title: Use reviewed statements only while accepted, authorised, current and relevant
requirements.notes: M03 bridge and console focus are integrated. Private data remains gated by M02/M05.

requirements.title: Valid time, recorded time, disputes and supersession
requirements.notes: First-party value-free review-transition history, migration/unknown times, fixed valid periods after first decision, disputes, supersession lineage, support observations and deterministic as-of reports are integrated. No general temporal query language or semantic conflict detector. Supersession does not preserve the old statement as true for an earlier period; history export and optional external adapter decision remain open.

requirements.title: Hybrid retrieval earns its complexity against a lexical baseline
requirements.notes: 44 frozen synthetic questions: keyword recall about 0.92, authorised-subset FTS5 about 0.90, no measured strict-grant leakage, about 76% irrelevant packet context. Keywords stay default; hybrid retrieval is not built. Track A measures better packet/link selection, not a presumed new engine.

requirements.title: Access applied before retrieval, traversal and egress; recheck before response
requirements.notes: Strict grants/epochs/model-purpose checks and source-filtered graph counts exist, with partial admin/enrolment. Grant loss withholds rather than destroys reviews. Job visibility/results have source checks. Legacy defaults remain; audit approval-visibility concern needs reproduction, not a claim of exploit or fix.

requirements.title: Correct, delete and revoke through all dependents
requirements.notes: Statement/entity forget receipts, dependent-answer withdrawal, draft cancellation, whole-source removal and journal-replaying restore exist. Value-free history remains. Complete copy accounting, encryption and secure erasure are not established.

requirements.title: Vault writes are a separate approved capability
requirements.notes: Create-only ALFRED/Inbox notes with inbox.write grant, exact fingerprinted approval and read-back. No unrestricted vault editing.

requirements.title: Rebuildable indexes and projections without losing history
requirements.notes: Offline atomic note/link/anchor rebuild preserves catalogue identity, revisions and reviews, reports changes and does not revive invalidated claims; version 1-to-2 migration tested. Connector re-import, not connector rebuild; no HTTP/scheduled rebuild.

requirements.title: Portable exports and retention settings
requirements.notes: Credential-scoped JSON/Markdown export with hashed manifest, explicit exclusions and private files outside vaults. Missing in-record redaction, encryption, index/receipt/history coverage and HTTP/console export.

requirements.title: File sync distinct from identity, ledger and runtime sync
requirements.notes: Known Syncthing/Dropbox/Nextcloud conflict copies are recorded and excluded from indexing; placement guard rejects recognised sync/Git/vault locations. Other clients, network-filesystem detection and real-client acceptance remain incomplete. No live database sync.

requirements.title: Procedures are reviewed descriptions, never executable because retrieved
requirements.notes: Read-only procedure registry with source/review state and tests showing instruction-like text changes no grants, credentials, approvals, settings, jobs or files. Versioned workflow learning/review remains future work.

requirements.title: Authored links, reviewed claims and suggestions visually distinct
requirements.notes: Separate authored note references, reviewed claims and review-support layers. No speculative suggestion layer exists, so none is invented.

requirements.title: Persistent person identity, paired devices, scoped credentials, revocation
requirements.notes: Identity records, strict grant mode/epochs, grant HTTP flows, invitations, offline rotation, single-use bounded pairing and own-device revocation exist. Missing strict defaults, shared per-person review history, multi-owner administration and team roles.

requirements.title: Private storage, secrets, exports, backups and restore
requirements.notes: Consistent backups and lifecycle-journal replay exist. Application encryption/key custody is not implemented; restore tests are not complete physical-erasure proof.
requirements.owner_decision_needed: Key custody and recovery model, including eventual always-on use, before crypto adoption/private activation.

requirements.title: Replaceable reasoning runtime and bounded context assembly
requirements.notes: Bounded context and optional tool-free local model adapter; console uses the existing queue. No dependable reasoning runtime selected.

requirements.title: Evaluate answer support, missing facts, contradictions and context
requirements.notes: Literal support report and deterministic source-mode cases with denominators/failures exist. They measure accounting, not semantic entailment or model quality. Restricted live-model comparison remains blocked.

requirements.title: Exact approvals, outbox, idempotency and result verification
requirements.notes: Existing ledger serves console proposals/approvals/cancellation and local drafts; vault.inbox_note is create-only with read-back. No external effects. Source-level approval visibility is an audit investigation, not a confirmed new bug/fix.

requirements.title: Task-aware attention and authorised routines
requirements.notes: Pulse plus stated attention/insight rules and authored commitment/morning routines, schedules, budgets, quiet hours, pause and cited run accounting are integrated. Draft offers require exact approval. In-app only; fixed UTC offsets, paired-device authorship and learned relevance remain unresolved/unmeasured.

requirements.title: Official account and device connectors with least access
requirements.notes: Read-only owner-selected .ics/.vcf importers, connector.read purpose, freshness and console controls exist. Items are unchecked export reports; no live account, network token or origin write.
requirements.owner_decision_needed: First provider/account and permitted test data for read-only workflow, then a separately approved harmless write.

requirements.title: Voice with honest generated, played and acknowledged states
requirements.notes: Output-only read-aloud chooses on-device voices; generated/played device report/acknowledgement differ and server keeps a hash rather than text. Scripted synthesis tests, not hardware/audio acceptance. No microphone.
requirements.owner_decision_needed: Whether/where microphone use is permitted and actual device acceptance; no listening implied by output.

requirements.title: Role-limited team and operational workspaces; specialist adapters
requirements.notes: Team/operational capability not started. OPS-002 contract is not a real specialist interface. Team roles wait on mature identity and grants; the plan being merged is not implementation.

requirements.title: Premium operational and executive console
requirements.notes: Approved console refinement is connected to real backend records. Preserve it. Software-rendered checks do not establish target-device visual/pointer/recovery acceptance or an installed native application.

requirements.title: Explicit host lifecycle, pause, recovery, offline and health
requirements.notes: Foreground local host, worker thread, pause/resume and health report exist. No managed/installed service, offline-first runtime, native package or hosted platform. Current stage allows local reliability work and native/cloud research without activation.

requirements.title: Project-centred focus shared by inspector, graph and next question
requirements.notes: Shared graph/inspector/question focus works; executive IDs load correctly. One workspace per credential remains; this is not the final shared-person multi-workspace experience.

requirements.title: Executive records: goals, priorities, commitments, decisions, milestones, follow-up
requirements.notes: Actor-private versioned records, responsible labels/explicit person links, decision options/reopen trails, assembled briefs, in-app attention/snooze and derived insights exist. Missing meeting-record/preparation workflow, follow-up-to-draft linkage and external delivery. Recorded bounded classification retained, not blanket completion.

requirements.title: Distributed operation across trusted nodes with one job authority
requirements.notes: Single-host stage 0 has durable job authority, leases, heartbeat, cancellation, bounded retry, unknown-effect reconciliation and event cursors. No second node or mesh. Later always-on recommendation is research, not an approved data-location change.
requirements.owner_decision_needed: Authoritative host, data residency/egress, remote transport/mesh, keys, region and spend before deployment.

requirements.title: Isolated bounded jobs on local or remote workers
requirements.notes: Allowlisted first-party local subprocesses with permitted inputs, time/output limits and no child credentials; connected job view/reconnect. Not a VM, sandbox, arbitrary agent executor or remote worker. Research/prototypes do not select boxd/E2B/OpenShell.
requirements.owner_decision_needed: Isolation/backend and persistent-versus-disposable lifecycle, actual project identity/licence, permitted data/forks, provider or self-host and budget before activation.

requirements.title: Expandable file access with bounded cache and explicit offline availability
requirements.notes: Bounded content-addressed local cache with hard limit, LRU, pins and hash verification. No cloud storage. Space/pCloud experience and open/self-hosted alternatives remain research.
requirements.owner_decision_needed: Object/file tier, region, custody, scope egress, retention and spending ceiling before provisioning.

requirements.title: Common capability contract for independent specialist products
requirements.notes: Contract v1 validates manifests/observations, labels simulation/assessment, keeps per-product source credentials and never enables declared actions. Synthetic adapter only; no real ENDSTATE/8BALL/Noir/Loc8/God's Eye interface is integrated.
requirements.owner_decision_needed: Accept/amend contract and supply authorised actual interfaces/terms before each real adapter.
